newsitem.title: USA: ITT says board to consider offer Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: ITT says board to consider offer Feb 4.

text.p: ITT Corp said its board of directors will consider a $6.5 billion takeover offer from Hilton Hotels Corp at its regularly-scheduled meeting on Tuesday, February 4.
Spokesman Jim Gallagher said it was not known if the board would make a decision about the offer at the meeting.

He added that he considered it "highly unlikely" the board's evaluation and analysis of the offer would be completed by that time and expected the company to take the 10 days allowed by law to respond to the offer.
"It's a regularly-scheduled board meeting so they'll obviously be discussing a number of corporate items, he said.

"Obviously, first and foremost on the agenda will be the offer. Our management has already begun to provide (the board) with the kind of information they'll need in order to make a careful and deliberate examination of the offer and put them in a position to make a recommendation to shareholders."
